title: Targeting of HPV E6 at the binding sites to the host-cell E6AP, p53, and the endoplasmic reticulum-resident chaperone, GRP78.
authors: Elfiky, Abdo A; Saied, Hazem R; Ali, Maha A
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向HPV E6与宿主蛋白（E6AP、p53、GRP78）结合位点的小分子抑制剂，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但分子对接与MD方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模，故给5分。
abstract: Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) represents an etiological factor for many cancer types, especially cervical cancer. Its oncoprotein E6 sheds drug designers who aim to stop its cellular protein associations, such as p53 and E6AP. Recently, it was discovered that the host-cell chaperone glucose-regulated protein 78 (GRP78) plays a crucial function in HPV infectivity by association with the viral E6 and E7 proteins. Therefore, we aimed to test small molecules inhibitor that could contradict the association between E6 and cellular factors E6AP, GRP78, and p53. Methods: In this study, molecular docking protocol was elaborated to test 115 small molecule compounds against the three binding sites of HPV E6 to the host-cell proteins; E6AP, p53, and GRP78. After that, molecular dynamics simulation and free energy calculations were performed on the best three complexes. Results: The results reveal the potency of 18 compounds against the HPV E6 at different binding sites, which give lower free energies than paclitaxel (positive control). The best two compounds, hypericin, and anabsinthin, could bind effectively and stably during the 100 ns MD simulation period to HPV E6. The calculated average free energies for hypericin and anabsinthin are -18.76 and -14.40 kcal/mol, respectively. They formed stable complexes with the three binding sites by forming hydrophobic contacts. The key residues that stabilize the two ligands in HPV E6 binding sites are V31, Y32, V62, and Y70 (E6AP), P13, C16, T22, I23 and A46 (p53), and M1, V31, L50, L67, and Q107 (GRP78). Conclusions: The best two compounds, hypericin, and anabsinthin, are potential candidates against HPV E6 at the host-cell factors binding sites, hence could block the oncoprotein activity of E6 in infected cells. Further experimental validation is yet to be performed and suggested as future work.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 背景：人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）是多种癌症类型的病因学因素，尤其是宫颈癌。其癌蛋白E6使旨在阻断其细胞蛋白关联（如p53和E6AP）的药物设计者面临挑战。近期发现，宿主细胞伴侣蛋白葡萄糖调节蛋白78（GRP78）通过与病毒E6和E7蛋白的关联在HPV感染性中发挥关键作用。因此，我们旨在测试能够拮抗E6与细胞因子E6AP、GRP78和p53之间关联的小分子抑制剂。方法：在本研究中，我们制定了分子对接方案，以测试115种小分子化合物对HPV E6与宿主细胞蛋白E6AP、p53和GRP78三个结合位点的作用。随后，对最佳三个复合物进行了分子动力学模拟和自由能计算。结果：结果显示，18种化合物在不同结合位点对HPV E6具有效力，其自由能低于紫杉醇（阳性对照）。最佳两种化合物金丝桃素（hypericin）和苦艾素（anabsinthin）在100 ns分子动力学模拟期间能有效且稳定地结合HPV E6。金丝桃素和苦艾素的计算平均自由能分别为-18.76和-14.40 kcal/mol。它们通过形成疏水接触与三个结合位点形成稳定复合物。稳定HPV E6结合位点中两种配体的关键残基为V31、Y32、V62和Y70（E6AP），P13、C16、T22、I23和A46（p53），以及M1、V31、L50、L67和Q107（GRP78）。结论：最佳两种化合物金丝桃素和苦艾素是针对宿主细胞因子结合位点HPV E6的潜在候选物，因此可能阻断感染细胞中E6的癌蛋白活性。进一步的实验验证尚待进行，并建议作为未来工作。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
